headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 6, 2026**
article:
The San Francisco Giants dominated the Chicago Cubs 18-3, securing a decisive win behind Matt Chapman's two home runs and eight RBIs. The Philadelphia Phillies took down the Chicago White Sox 8-6, with Randal Grichuk leading the charge at the plate. The Boston Red Sox edged out the New York Yankees with a final score of 5-3, securing their win behind Willson Contreras' strong performance.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Quinn Priester (Milwaukee Brewers) who has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to right thoracic outlet syndrome. Tyler Glasnow (Los Angeles Dodgers) has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with low back spasms. Austin Wells (New York Yankees) has been placed on the 10-day injured list with cervical headaches. The Los Angeles Angels have placed Gustavo Campero on the 10-day injured list with a right hand fracture and Jorge Soler on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 4, 2026, with a left oblique strain.

Several roster moves have taken place, including the Milwaukee Brewers acquiring Joel Kuhnel from the Athletics for cash. The Boston Red Sox have traded for Joe La Sorsa from the Pittsburgh Pirates. The Cincinnati Reds have traded Kyle Nicolas to the Baltimore Orioles for cash. The Atlanta Braves have acquired Austin Wynns from the Los Angeles Angels for cash. The Toronto Blue Jays have traded for Simeon Woods Richardson from the Minnesota Twins for cash.

top_news.title: **Giants Blast Past Cubs in Blowout Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Chicago Cubs 18-3, securing a decisive win. Matt Chapman led the Giants' offense with a pair of home runs and eight RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Fall to Tigers in 7-3 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners suffered a 7-3 loss to the Detroit Tigers, with Framber Valdez earning the win after 5.0 IP, 5 K, 1 ER, 2 BB, 5 H. Kerry Carpenter led the Tigers' offense with 1 H, 1 HR, 2 RBI, and 4 AB.

top_news.title: **Phillies Take Down White Sox 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 6-8 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Randal Grichuk leading the charge at the plate, going 2 for 3 with 2 home runs and 2 RBIs. Brandon Eisert made a strong relief appearance, striking out 2 batters in 1 inning of work.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Yankees in Thrilling 5-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox edged out the New York Yankees with a final score of 5-3, securing their win. Willson Contreras led the Red Sox offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Out Tigers 4-0**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a dominant 4-0 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Bryce Miller leading the way on the mound. Randy Arozarena and Dominic Canzone were among the impact hitters for the winning team.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Twins in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals took down the Minnesota Twins 3-2, securing a crucial win in their matchup. Carter Jensen, Bobby Witt Jr., Vinnie Pasquantino, and Orlando Arcia all made significant contributions to the Royals' victory.

top_news.title: **Brewers RHP Quinn Priester Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Quinn Priester has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to right thoracic outlet syndrome. This move marks a significant update to the team's roster.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Bullpen with Kuhnel Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have added right-handed pitcher Joel Kuhnel to their roster, acquired in a trade with the Athletics for cash. Kuhnel joins the Brewers' pitching staff.
